entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • GitHub Copilot Chat Assistant. What would you like me to do with that file/URL? Options I can do now — pick one: 1) Open and show the contents of IConfiguration.cs and explain its members. 2) Explain how IConfiguration relates to your HttpClient defaults snippet and how to use configuration there. 3) Find where AddServiceDiscovery() is defined (or show how to implement it). 4) Show commit/blame history for that file or the specific commit you linked. 5) Search the repo for usages of ConfigureHttpClientDefaults or AddServiceDiscovery. Tell me which option (or describe a different task) and I’ll proceed. #52645
  • Running `dotnet run file.cs` on empty file produces a misleading compiloation error #52644
  • Consider Pre-Downloading in `dotnetup` walkthrough #52643
  • No data on reportinstallsuccess for .NET 10 #52642
  • ArtifactsPath-using projects break sourcelinking if the ArtifactsPath is outside of a known repo root. #52639
  • [dotnet test MTP] Consider backporting #52449 (allow project as positional arg) to 10.0.3xx #52636
    10.0.3xx
  • Publishing multi-arch images depends on Docker Desktop #52634
  • Unable to build project using VS 18.2.1: “DiscoverPrecompressedAssets” task failed unexpectedly. An item with the same key has already been added #52647
  • Can we skip "Skipping NuGet package signature verification" message? #52630
  • Consider dropping support (no longer building) win-x86 SDK #52628
